pages.text: The handheld is the easiest radio: no antenna, no wiring.$(li)$(thing)Hold right click$() to talk (push to talk).$(li)$(thing)Sneak and right click$() to open it: frequency, volume, and the $(thing)tone$() and $(thing)offset$() pages (press ENTER) used with $(l:radiocraft:repeaters/repeater)repeaters$(/l).

It runs on a $(item)small battery$(): a few days of normal use. Hold the handheld in your off hand and sneak-use a battery in your main hand to swap them, or charge it in a $(item)desk charger$().$(br2)Range is a few hundred blocks by line of sight; a $(l:radiocraft:repeaters/repeater)repeater$(/l) on a hill extends it.
pages.title: Battery
